title: Sakamoto desu ga?: Sakamoto Deshita?
justification: AniList 21862 (OVA, 1 episode(s) from 2016-09-26) is AniDB 11881's special(s) S1, aired 2016-09-27. AniList's PREQUEL relation names AniList 21595, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 11881, and the special's title matches an AniList title. On TMDB 65944 the parent's node places the special(s) where TMDB's dates disagree (AniDB S1 aired 2016-09-27, TMDB 65944 S0E1 2016-10-26), so the bridged record publishes no TMDB value.
